svg.title: ArchFlow individual and team onboarding flow
svg.desc: An individual or team moves from orientation through a first mission, bounded context, adaptive teamwork, validation, and learning while functional roles contribute bounded outputs and authority interrupts protect risky decisions.
svg.text: Individual and team onboarding — one mission spine, adaptive responsibilities
A person or team gets the smallest useful context and next task; functional roles join only when they own an output, check, approval, or handoff.

g.text: Onboarding guide shows responsibility and escalation.
One owner per output; bounded handoffs.

text.tspan: one writer for each shared file
The dashboard shows role, evidence freshness, next action,
reviewer, blocker, and the exact done condition.
Pause on missing requirements, material contradiction,
private data, external action, or irreversible change.
Freeze candidate; reviewer reports findings; maker repairs;
reviewer verifies the exact repaired result.
A person or team can explain why, find the source, perform the safe action, and escalate uncertainty.
Only reviewed reusable meaning enters solution memory with source lineage, freshness, review date, and supersession.
